game_name: Super Street Fighter II: The New Challengers Super 2 (USA 930911)
general_issues: Select ssf2us2.zip; keep parent archives, keys and required qsound.zip beside it. Experimental emulation; profile coverage does not mean full gameplay qualification. TPO automatically assigns up to 2 computers. Each computer controls one player on the shared cabinet using its Player 1 controls. Rollback uses a canonical two-frame input delay; every linked cabinet and serial queue is restored together. Offline EEPROM and manual cabinet settings are ignored during online play.
